Feature Heading: Flight Search and Fare Discovery
Feature Description: Build flight search across origin, destination, travel dates, passenger counts, cabin classes, nonstop preferences, and flexible dates. Return available itineraries with fare families, schedules, duration, and key restrictions.

Feature Heading: Passenger Profile and Traveler Management
Feature Description: Allow customers to create and maintain traveler profiles with contact information, date of birth, travel documents, special assistance requests, and saved passenger details for faster booking.

Feature Heading: Secure Payment and Booking Confirmation
Feature Description: Implement secure card payments, payment authorization, booking creation, payment retry handling, receipts, and booking confirmation. Prevent duplicate charges and maintain payment status throughout checkout.

Feature Heading: Seat Selection and Cabin Upgrade
Feature Description: Provide interactive seat selection with seat maps, seat availability, paid seat pricing, preferred seats, extra-legroom options, and cabin upgrade offers during booking and post-booking servicing.

Feature Heading: Online Check-in and Digital Boarding Pass
Feature Description: Enable eligible passengers to check in online, confirm passenger information, select or change seats, acknowledge travel requirements, and generate digital boarding passes with scannable barcodes.

Feature Heading: Baggage Purchase and Tracking
Feature Description: Support prepaid baggage purchase, baggage allowance display, bag tag association, baggage status tracking, carousel information, and customer notifications when baggage status changes.

Feature Heading: Real-time Flight Status and Notifications
Feature Description: Provide real-time flight status including departure, arrival, gate, delay, cancellation, and boarding updates. Send configurable push, email, and SMS notifications for important travel events.

Feature Heading: Flight Disruption and Self-service Rebooking
Feature Description: Detect delays and cancellations that impact a customer's itinerary and provide eligible alternate flights. Support self-service rebooking, connection protection, and disruption-related customer notifications.

Feature Heading: Cancellation and Automated Refund Processing
Feature Description: Allow eligible bookings to be cancelled and calculate refundable amounts based on fare rules. Automate refund initiation, refund status tracking, payment reversal, and customer refund notifications.

Feature Heading: Loyalty Account and Reward Redemption
Feature Description: Integrate loyalty accounts so customers can view balances, earn points from eligible travel, redeem rewards during booking, and review loyalty transaction history.

Feature Heading: Travel Credits and Voucher Management
Feature Description: Create, validate, apply, and track airline travel credits and promotional vouchers. Enforce expiration, currency, ownership, and usage rules while preventing duplicate redemption.

Feature Heading: Ancillary Services and Special Assistance
Feature Description: Allow customers to request meals, wheelchair assistance, pet travel, priority boarding, lounge access, and other ancillary services while validating eligibility and operational constraints.

Feature Heading: Multi-city and International Booking
Feature Description: Extend booking to multi-city and international itineraries with passport information, destination requirements, international fare rules, connecting segments, and traveler document validation.

Feature Heading: Booking Management and Itinerary Servicing
Feature Description: Provide a manage-booking experience for retrieving reservations, updating contact details, reviewing itinerary changes, modifying eligible flights, managing seats, and accessing receipts and travel documents.

Feature Heading: Airport Operations Gate and Boarding Integration
Feature Description: Integrate customer-facing travel experiences with gate and boarding events. Surface gate changes, boarding groups, boarding status, final-call events, and boarded passenger status from operational systems.

Feature Heading: Customer Support Booking Assistance
Feature Description: Provide support agents with booking lookup, itinerary context, payment and refund status, disruption history, baggage events, and controlled servicing actions to resolve customer travel issues.

Feature Heading: Personalized Travel Recommendations
Feature Description: Generate personalized destination, schedule, cabin, and ancillary recommendations using customer preferences and recent travel behavior while respecting privacy and recommendation eligibility rules.

Feature Heading: Fare Alerts and Price Monitoring
Feature Description: Allow customers to monitor selected routes and travel dates for fare changes. Generate alerts when prices fall below configured thresholds or when meaningful fare changes occur.

Feature Heading: Corporate Travel Policy and Approval
Feature Description: Support corporate travelers with company travel policies, preferred fares, cost-center capture, approval workflows, out-of-policy warnings, and business travel reporting.

Feature Heading: Platform Reliability and Booking Observability
Feature Description: Improve booking-platform reliability with distributed tracing, transaction correlation, payment and booking metrics, alerting, retry visibility, operational dashboards, and failure diagnostics across critical travel flows.
